text:
Incident Bot: PAGER: high p99 latency detected for streaming endpoints in us-west-2. alert: router.p99 > 5s for 8m. possible routing skew after last policy rollout. paging @Tilly (oncall). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/2461234567 :rotating_light:

Tilly (oncall): ack. I'm on it. can someone grab the routing diff for last 24h?

Mike R: looking now — p95 up ~300ms, p99 jump to 6-8s. streaming stalls (grpc) + tail queues back up. top anomaly is concentrated on flows hitting shard-37 and shard-42.

Priya M: I just checked the routing policy commits — neighbor-zone-affinity was promoted yesterday at 03:08 UTC (commit 9f3b2a7). that policy increases weight to nearby zones for low-latency routing, but it can create hot partitions if hotkeys concentrate.

Ash: That matches. our telemetry shows weight skewing toward eu-west-1 adjacent pool for a subset of us-west flows. hot partitioning + KV cache churn => stalls.

Tilly (oncall): can we hotfix? emergency mitigation options: 1) roll back policy 2) set emergency override weights 3) add fallback to cached model variant. priorities: reduce p99 now, preserve availability.

Eric (router): I can push a zone-weight override. propose: set weight for neighbor-zone eu-west-1 to 0 for affected shards while we investigate. command:

```
# emergency override (dry-run first)
rctl set-shard-override --shard=shard-37,shard-42 --zone=eu-west-1 --weight=0.0 --reason="egress-neighbor-zone-skew-emergency-2461234567"
```

Infra Bot: executing override request. will run dry-run and report results.

Infra Bot: dry-run result: routes for shard-37/42 would shift 92% of traffic away from eu-west-1 to local pools (us-west-2). no config validation errors.

Mike R: rapid note — moving traffic back to local pools will increase per-token cost a bit but should collapse p99 quickly. streaming stalls should drop if KV cache hotset spreads out.

Tilly (oncall): go for it, Eric. apply the override and watch p95/p99. lean on infra-bot to confirm.

Infra Bot: applying override now...

Infra Bot: success. override id ov-20260315-01 applied. propagated to fleets in ~18s.

Mike R: metrics update: p99 down from ~7.2s to ~1.1s over the last 60s. p95 back to ~220ms. looks like the override mitigated tail. streaming stall count trending down. :thumbsup:

Lena (CS): heads up — support signal: three customers reported degraded streaming sessions in the last hour. two timed out after 10s, one saw repeated reconnects. I'm drafting a proactive note to affected customers. need list of affected customer ids and window.

Tilly (oncall): @Lena sending customer list in 1m. we'll include mitigation steps and ETA for root cause.

Priya M: root cause hypothesis: neighbor-zone-affinity policy created routing weight concentration for a subset of keys (hotkeys) that caused a hot shard in the neighbor region. that shard's KV cache thrash caused backpressure and per-request stalls for streaming requests. config rollout lacked a throttle for per-shard weight increases.

Eric (router): adding logs from router leader during the spike:

```
[2026-03-15T11:56:02Z] ROUTER(INFO) shard-42 weight=0.92 -> receiving 68% more flows
[2026-03-15T11:56:04Z] LB(WARN) hotkey-detect key=usr:98724 spike=0.81
[2026-03-15T11:56:07Z] KVCACHE(ERR) eviction-rate=0.43ms growth=200x stream-hold=locked
[2026-03-15T11:56:12Z] STREAM(ERR) stall detected conn=abcd1234 timeout=10s
```

Ash: good logs. that eviction-rate line indicates thrash. we need a policy-level guard that caps weight delta per-shard per-rollout.

Tilly (oncall): agree as a follow-up. immediate: keep override in place until we have a safe rollback plan. Priya, can you prepare a rollback PR for the neighbor-zone-affinity promotion? include a canary with per-shard rate limits.

Priya M: on it. I'll open PR + link to rollback config. target change: revert the promotion and add per-shard delta limit = 0.15. PR will include automated test for hotkey concentration.

Mike R: also recommend adding a short-lived emergency route: if any shard sees >50% traffic shift in <5m, route-engine should trigger an auto-throttle. we can triage that in postmortem.

Lena (CS): customer note draft: "We detected elevated streaming latency affecting a small number of customers in us-west-2 due to an internal routing policy change. We applied an emergency mitigation to restore normal performance at 11:56 UTC. We're investigating and will follow up with a postmortem." sending now.

Tilly (oncall): nice. assign owners: Priya = postmortem + rollback, Eric = router follow-up (autoscale/guards), Ash = infra mitigation (cache limits), Mike = telemetry + alarm tuning, Lena = customer comms. I'll stay on until 14:00 UTC and then hand off to Mike if still open.

Priya M: opened rollback PR #4387 -> https://git.redwood/routing/pulls/4387. snapshot of change and proposed guard included. requesting review from @Eric (router) and @Ash.

Eric (router): reviewing PR. quick note — prefer to keep a canary with weight cap 0.2 instead of full revert, so we can test neighbor-zone benefits safely. will comment on PR.

Tilly (oncall): ok. we leave emergency override ov-20260315-01 in place until 12:30 UTC, then reassess. timeline for postmortem: prep initial timeline today, full write-up tomorrow.

Infra Bot: override ov-20260315-01 set to auto-expire at 12:30 UTC unless extended.

Mike R: telemetry action: adding a short-lived p99 alert for any shard with >3x baseline traffic and KV evictions >0.1/s. will roll out in 10m.

Lena (CS): customers notified. two replied asking for incident start/end times and logs. sharing affected customer ids: cust-7391, cust-1209, cust-4412.

Tilly (oncall): thanks. log window: 11:50–11:58 UTC. include override id and mitigations.

Priya M: postmortem owner set. I'll capture timeline, diff, telemetry, and action items: (1) add per-shard weight delta guard, (2) add auto-throttle on rapid shifts, (3) improve canary sizing, (4) incident runbook update for routing overrides, (5) CS templated messages.

Tilly (oncall): any outstanding items?

Ash: confirm we need a formal rollout change: modify promotion pipeline to compute expected hotkey risk score and cap weight change for high-risk shards. I'll pair with Priya.

Eric (router): will put in router metric to emit shard-weight-delta events; also adding circuit breaker to shed new flows if eviction rate > threshold.

Mike R: monitoring shows steady state now. p99 ~1.0s, stream stall count normalized. I'll keep an eye for 30m and then remove the emergency override if stable.

Tilly (oncall): thanks all. handing off to Mike at 13:30 UTC if still stable. Postmortem owners looped. closing thread after follow-up. :white_check_mark:
